title: Guided Response enhancement scope is distinct from base entitlement
problem: The ES 8.6 task guide and later ES 8.7 capability matrix describe different version and enhancement scopes; an updated explicit base-entitlement interpretation remains an audit follow-up.

audiences: Customers and documentation readers evaluating the stated decision
exclusions: No tenant rollout, entitlement, authorization or environment-specific approval is inferred.

impact.customerScenario: A reader compares Guided Response availability between Essentials and Premier.
impact.consequence: A later Premier enhancement label cannot safely be treated as removal of base access.

confidence.rationale: Historical published observations are normalized without creating a new source review or numeric confidence score.

lifecycle.reason: No withdrawal, merge or supersession is recorded.

evidence.statement: The audit records a both-edition prerequisite statement in the ES 8.6 task guide.
